title: change-log-2024-12-16
body_markdown:
[Back](https://atlas.so/changelog)


Dec 16th, 2024


✍️ Convert Tickets into Help Center Articles


With just **one click** , you can transform customer support tickets into **ready-to-publish Help Center articles** .


**Now you can enjoy:**


- **Auto-drafted content** : The article is built from the messages within the ticket.
- **Streamlined publishing** : No more copying, pasting, or rewriting ticket replies—just review, edit if needed, and publish.


And here’s how it works:


1. You have a ticket that can potentially be converted into a help center article
2. You click the hamburger menu and select "Turn ticket into Help Center article”
3. Atlas drafts the article for you using the ticket messages, creating a ready-to-review doc


This update makes it easier than ever to build out your Help Center as you go, while keeping support docs relevant, up-to-date, and directly tied to real customer inquiries.


Give it a try and let us know how this feature is helping you.
